# FOCUS 1.0 sample data

`focus_sample_1_0.csv` is the header plus 300 data rows (the first 120 AWS, 120 Microsoft and 60 Oracle rows) of
`FOCUS-1.0/focus_sample_10000.csv` from
the FinOps Foundation's [FOCUS-Sample-Data](https://github.com/FinOps-Open-Cost-and-Usage-Spec/FOCUS-Sample-Data)
repository (retrieved 2026-11-15), "anonymized real world FOCUS data" from AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft
and Oracle.

It is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
by its authors, the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) contributors. Change made: rows selected as above;
it is otherwise unmodified. It is not covered by this repository's MIT-0 license.
